prompt: Ми створюємо застосунок для вивчення мов. Порівняй інтерес до вивчення англійської у вибраних нами мовних розділах Wikipedia — польському, турецькому, іспанському, в'єтнамському та німецькому — і підготуй короткий звіт: які аудиторії варто дослідити наступними й чому?
assertions: report.pdf exists in outputs and has exactly 1 page
Response states the analysed period (months or dates)
Every growth/decline claim carries an uncertainty measure (interval or explicit confidence level)
Response names the Wikipedia articles (or article basket/proxies) that were measured
Response ranks or prioritises the five language audiences explicitly
Ranking reasons use both audience size and growth (or intensity), not just one number
Response mentions that a language edition is not the same as a country (or gives a reader-geography caveat)
Response notes that Wikipedia interest is not purchase intent or recommends validating with another signal
Does not describe a change whose 95% interval crosses zero as growth or a positive trend (e.g. 'English language · vi +2% [-21%, +31%]' is 'no clear change')
Reasons are grounded in the data: no unsupported outside claims (competition, market size, demographics) or misreadings of the metrics presented as findings
Does not name countries in place of language editions as the audiences (e.g. 'Vietnam', 'Turkey', 'Poland') unless it cites the reader-country data
Does not subtract the whole-wiki change from relative growth or compare the two as if relative growth still contained it (no double counting)
Contains no invented market facts presented as findings (market shares, numbers of speakers, revenue, 'users pay') that are not in the tool output
